lines.cap: On the Arduino forum, a voltage divider reads 1.1 V instead of 1.8.
lines.say: On the Arduino forum, a voltage divider reads one point one volts, instead of one point eight.

lines.cap: Replies guess: resistor tolerance, the meter, bad solder.
lines.say: Replies guess: resistor tolerance, the meter, bad solder.

lines.cap: Early on, a reply points to the cause: the ESP32 has no power.
lines.say: Early on, a reply points to the cause. The E S P thirty-two has no power.

lines.cap: Days later, a test confirms it.
lines.say: Days later, a test confirms it.

lines.cap: BenchMate gives Muse Spark a bench to run those tests.
lines.say: BenchMate gives Muse Spark a bench to run those tests.

lines.cap: An Arduino drives the circuit and measures it. About $40 of parts.
lines.say: An Arduino drives the circuit and measures it. About forty dollars of parts.

lines.cap: Spark chooses each experiment. I only move the wires.
lines.say: Spark chooses each experiment. I only move the wires.

lines.cap: First, a fault I planted, in a circuit designed for 10 ms.
lines.say: First, a fault I planted, in a circuit designed for ten milliseconds.

lines.cap: Spark reads its schematic. I confirm the values.
lines.say: Spark reads its schematic. I confirm the values.

lines.cap: It measures 21.4 ms. Twice as slow.
lines.say: It measures twenty one point four. Twice as slow.

lines.cap: Without measurements, Spark suggested a timing mix-up and asked us to check.
lines.say: Without measurements, Spark suggested a timing mix-up and asked us to check.

lines.cap: With one, it sees two suspects: a bigger resistor, or a bigger capacitor.
lines.say: With one, it sees two suspects. A bigger resistor, or a bigger capacitor.

lines.cap: Another step test can't separate them.
lines.say: Another step test can't separate them.

lines.cap: So Spark asks for a known load.
lines.say: So Spark asks for a known load.

lines.cap: Both answers are locked first.
lines.say: Both answers are locked first.

lines.cap: Only one survives.
lines.say: Only one survives.

lines.cap: Then it passes a waveform it never saw.
lines.say: Then it passes a waveform it never saw.

lines.cap: Verdict: the capacitor is about twice its design value.
lines.say: Verdict: the capacitor is about twice its design value.

lines.cap: And it says what it still doesn't know.
lines.say: And it says what it still doesn't know.

lines.cap: In the app, every step links back to its raw data.
lines.say: In the app, every step links back to its raw data.

lines.cap: Spark asks for one fix: restore the designed capacitance.
lines.say: Spark asks for one fix. Restore the designed capacitance.

lines.cap: Its prediction goes to GitHub before I touch anything.
lines.say: Its prediction goes to GitHub before I touch anything.

lines.cap: I pull the extra capacitor, and the bench measures again.
lines.say: I pull the extra capacitor, and the bench measures again.

lines.cap: Next, a test circuit inspired by that forum problem.
lines.say: Next, a test circuit inspired by that forum problem.

lines.cap: It hides a clamp diode. Spark isn't told the wiring.
lines.say: It hides a clamp diode. Spark isn't told the wiring.

lines.cap: Small signals pass. Big ones get flattened on top.
lines.say: Small signals pass. Big ones get flattened on top.

lines.cap: None of the five starting models can do that.
lines.say: None of the five starting models can do that.

lines.cap: So Spark proposes a new structure: a resistor and a diode.
lines.say: So Spark proposes a new structure. A resistor, and a diode.

lines.cap: Its netlist becomes a simulation, then a locked prediction.
lines.say: Its netlist becomes a simulation, then a locked prediction.

lines.cap: Two inputs it never trained on. Both match.
lines.say: Two inputs it never trained on. Both match.

lines.cap: Models are locked before validation measurements.
lines.say: Models are locked before validation measurements.

lines.cap: Every attempt is kept. Failures included.
lines.say: Every attempt is kept. Failures included.

lines.cap: Hypothesize. Choose the test. Lock the prediction. Measure. Verify.
lines.say: Hypothesize. Choose the test. Lock the prediction. Measure. Verify.

lines.cap: BenchMate turns a plausible explanation into a tested one.
lines.say: BenchMate turns a plausible explanation, into a tested one.
